what: performance_budget r2 — GTAO external-scene-depth rework (src/engine/post.js). Reproduce: node tools/perfprobe.mjs [--dsf 2]. The probe now emits a budget block per run (p99 frame-time <=25 ms and triangles-median <=6M across all passes are new tracked lines).
fix: GTAOPass no longer re-rasterizes the scene into its own G-buffer (setGBuffer(sceneDepth) reuses the RenderPass depth; normals reconstructed from depth) — this also removes the DUPLICATE render of the two per-frame CSM cascades its internal renderer.render(scene) triggered, and a 260-420 m view-distance AO fade replaces the aoExclude visibility hack (fixes ridge AO slashes on the new horizon ring). Draw calls in battle: 858 median / 980 max -> 566/688 (both dsf), triangles 7.15M -> 5.55M median (subsequent content landed between measurements; my change alone measured 526/646 and 4.52M).

budgetGates.trianglesMedianMax: 7000000 hard (2026-07-28 content 6.36M +10%); ratchet target 6000000 after shadow-proxy LODs (handoff §4)
budgetGates.heapStable: min(raw trend, post-GC floor trend) <= 2 MB/s on 20 s windows (GC sawtooth tolerance); <= 1 MB/s on 40 s+ windows. 60 s controls: -0.43 MB/s (snapshot), heap flat-to-shrinking

heapControl60s.note: 60 s combat run: heap trends NEGATIVE — 20 s raw numbers swing with GC phase

methodNote: Runs taken on a synced snapshot of the tree during quiet windows (sibling agents were running their own headless-Chrome harnesses all evening; contended runs show bimodal p5/p99 and were retried, e.g. p5 32.9 with mean 155.6). drawCalls/triangles are renderer.info totals across ALL passes per frame (3 CSM cascade renders + main; the GTAO G-buffer prepass no longer exists) and are contention-independent: identical across every run at both dsf values.
liveTreeNote: Round-close live-tree spot runs: dsf1 156.2 median / 126.6 p5 fps, p99 11.1 ms, 580/715 calls, 6.35 M tris (content landed after the snapshot runs: canopy + community-tank work; creep flagged in handoff §4). Harness: node tools/screenshot.mjs exit 0, zero console errors.
